question: Will Venice Token (VVV) close above $15 by September 1?

model.prompt_context: This market resolves YES if the closing price of Venice Token (VVV), as reported in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Venice Token Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/venice-token/historical_data), is strictly greater than $15.00 for the row dated 2026-08-31 (the final UTC daily close before September 1, 2026). A closing price of exactly $15.00 or below resolves NO. Only the 2026-08-31 close is considered; intraday highs and closes on earlier dates do not count.
